spans.s: शठ् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pres. शठति) 1. To deceive, to defraud; 2. to hurt, to kill; 3. to suffer pain.
शठ् (II) vt. 10P pres. शठयति) To deceive, to defraud.
सठ् vt. 10U (pres. साठयति-ते) 1. To finish, to complete; 2. to leave unfinished; 3. to adorn; 4. to go, to move.
शठ (I) a. (f. ठा) Dishonest, perfidious, crafty, deceitful.

शठ (II) m. 1. A rogue, a knave, Bg.xviii.28; 2. a false lover (thus described in the S.D.- एकत्र बद्धभावो यः … दर्शितबहिरनुरागो विप्रियमन्यत्र गूढमाचरति), ध्रुवमस्मि शठः शुचिस्मिते विदितः कैतववत्सलस्त्व R.viii.49; 3. a fool, a blockhead; 4. a mediator, an umpire; 5. the Dhattūra plant.
शठ (I) a. (f. ठा) Dishonest, perfidious, crafty, deceitful.
शाठ्य n. Villainy, dishonesty, perfidy, roguery, आजन्मनः शाठ्यमशिक्षितो यः Sak.v.
